chunks: The Sabbath was imposed only on those who differed about it; and indeed your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection regarding what they differed about.
ai.seo_question: Why was the Sabbath imposed on the Israelites and what is its significance in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights that the Sabbath was not an original divine obligation for all humanity but a specific disciplinary measure imposed upon the Children of Israel due to their internal disputes over its observance. It underscores the principle that religious practices can be context-specific, with Allah serving as the ultimate arbiter of these differences on the Day of Resurrection.
